verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.yapily.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of markdown doc pages. First-party docs have a dedicated AI-agents page explaining how to connect Claude, Cursor, or other coding agents through MCP, llms.txt, or Agent Skills, and the MCP route gives agents a live, searchable connection to the docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents actually work well with these resources, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle.
